findings.detail: Source says 'Kurapika laughs humorously' immediately after Chrollo says revenge is the best therapy. The translation says 'Курапика невесело смеётся', reversing the literal emotional coloring (humorously -> without mirth). In light of the unusual source phrasing and scene context, use neutral 'Курапика коротко смеётся' instead of deciding the author meant humorlessly; preserve subsequent tension and tears.
